llms.demo: The observatory dataset is currently SIMULATED. Scores, citations, crawler behaviour, search volumes and CPC are generated to build and demonstrate the tool: they are not observed measurements. Do not cite those numbers as findings. This file reports none of them: it carries the method, the site structure and the page identity only.
llms.live: The figures published on the page are measured monthly across several runs per prompt and per assistant, and are to be read as a mean with its spread. This file does not carry them: it holds the method, the site structure and the page identity. The values live on the page and in the data endpoints.
